name: Gray-breasted Partridge
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern java
description: Unique partridge of Java’s eastern highlands, where it inhabits primary forest from 500 to 2200 meters. Dark gray overall with a distinctive bright white face, which sets it apart from all other gamebirds in its limited range.

name: Black Coucal
rangeDescription: Intra-african migrant south of the sahara
description: Small coucal of marshes, swamps, and wet grassland. Distinctive in breeding plumage: black with a rufous wing.

name: Congo Sunbird
rangeDescription: Democratic republic of the congo and congo (banks of upper congo and ubangi rivers)
description: A slim, long-billed sunbird in which males and females are very different. Males are mostly black and dark green, with a red band across the underparts and extremely elongated central tail feathers.

name: Topknot Pigeon
rangeDescription: Coastal eastern australia (cape york to southern new south wales)
description: A large solid pigeon with a unique waved crest on the back of the head. Almost entirely gray with darker wing feathers.

name: Harris's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Breeds north-central canada; winters to southern usa
description: Large sparrow that is largely restricted to the middle of North America. Breeds in boreal forest and shrubbery in the far north of central Canada, and winters in shrubby or weedy areas in the southern Great Plains.

name: White-collared Oliveback
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern democratic republic of the congo, western uganda, northern rwanda, burundi, and northwestern tanzania
description: Tiny olive-green, gray, and black member of the waxbill family. Males have a narrow white collar and an olive-green breast, while females lack the collar and have all-gray underparts.

name: Blue-headed Pitta
rangeDescription: Primary lowland forest of borneo
description: Small and unique gem-like pitta of Borneo’s lowland dipterocarp forests—both pristine and logged. Male’s glowing electric-blue crown is eye-catching even in the gloom of the forest floor; also note dark blue underparts, bright white throat, and cinnamon-brown back.

name: Purple-bearded Bee-eater
rangeDescription: Humid forest of sulawesi
description: An unmistakable large bee-eater with elongated central tail feathers, a green back and uppertail, and a diagnostic deep purple face and throat. Purple throat is more extensive in males.

name: Dusky Turtle-Dove
rangeDescription: Montane forest of eastern africa and southwestern arabia
description: Very dark dove with a black mark on the neck. When seen well, shows beautiful rufous edges to the wing feathers.

name: Tufted Coquette
rangeDescription: Eastern venezuela, trinidad, and the guianas to northern brazil
description: Tiny, ornately patterned hummingbird with a bold pale rump band. Exquisite adult male plumage features a bushy orange crest and long orange plumes tipped dark green, sweeping back from the cheeks over the shoulders, and set off by a white rump band and stout orange bill tipped black.

name: Vilcabamba Thistletail
rangeDescription: Southern peru (cordillera vilcabamba in cusco)
description: Rarely-seen thistletail found only in a small area of the high Andes north of the city of Abancay in southern Peru. It has a long tail, brown upperparts, gray underparts, and a faint tawny chin patch that is very indistinct on some birds.

name: Seychelles Parrot
rangeDescription: Seychelles (praslin and curieuse)
description: Fairly large, long-tailed dark gray parrot. Found locally in the granitic Seychelles, mainly on the island of Praslin.

name: Rotuma Myzomela
rangeDescription: Rotuma island (northwest of fiji)
description: A striking myzomela with beautifully contrasting plumage. Has a red chest and flanks and a bright crimson back and rump.

name: Mountain Barbet
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern borneo
description: Faded-looking barbet of Borneo’s north-central mountain ranges. Grass-green above and pale green below, with a pale blue head, an off-white throat, and a bright red streak on the back of the head.

name: Gray-headed Elaenia
rangeDescription: Southeastern peru, northern bolivia, and adjacent brazil (undescribed subspecies, not true caniceps?); eastern and southern bolivia southward to northwestern argentina and eastward to paraguay, northeastern argentina, and south-central and eastern brazil
description: Small flycatcher found in humid forest in lowlands and lower mountain slopes. Male is gray with paler underparts and dark wings with white wingbars.

name: Chatham Islands Snipe
rangeDescription: Chatham islands (rangitara, mangere, and star keys)
description: The smallest snipe of New Zealand and the only snipe present on the Chatham Islands. A small, rotund wader with mottled brown and black plumage.

name: Pirre Warbler
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of eastern panama and far northwestern colombia
description: This warbler has an extremely limited range near the border of Panama and Colombia. The head pattern is distinctive; look for the bold white eyebrow and reddish crown.

name: Rufous-bellied Euphonia
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to southern venezuela, northern bolivia (to western and northern santa cruz), and western amazonian brazil
description: Small finch-like bird of lowland rainforest. Male is glossy navy blue with a deep red-orange belly, fairly distinctive in its range; female is golden with gray wash on the head, back, and belly, and orange-red undertail coverts.

name: Lesser Roadrunner
rangeDescription: Arid western mexico (southern sonora) to northern nicaragua
description: Slightly smaller version of the familiar cartoon Greater Roadrunner, but usually the two species do not occur in the same places. Favors dry brushy woodland and overgrown weedy fields in tropical lowlands and foothills.

name: White-browed Conebill
rangeDescription: Andes of eastern peru (san martín) and western bolivia
description: Tiny bicolored tanager with a sharp, pointed bill. Orangey red below and bluish gray above, with a strong white eyebrow.
